graphEvents.label: Four phases claim Create on THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md
Parent notice row names the wrong phases

label: THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md is claimed as Create by phase 001, 006, 008 and 010, but only 001 can create it; 011 correctly marks Modify. Phase 006's own description says it is appended when 001 has already created the file, so the row knows it is an append and still says Create, and a phase following the row literally recreates the file and drops earlier entries. Change 006, 008 and 010 to Modify with an append description and state in the parent that 001 owns creation.

The parent scope table assigns THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md to 001, 002, 008, 009 and 010, but 002 has no notice requirement and lifts no code, 009 explicitly decides its skill wrapper needs no entry, and 006 and 011 both require notices yet are absent from the row. Change the phase list to 001, 006, 008, 010, 011 and note that 002 and 009 carry no entry.

direction: Treating the shared Modify sets as merge risks
reason: The phases run one at a time and the modify lists are strictly increasing in phase number, so a sequential build never merges two in-flight edits to the same file.

direction: Treating 011's THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES Modify row as wrong
reason: It is the only phase that correctly marks an append as Modify, which is the model the other phases should copy.
